::: {.software-intro}
Official economic data is often fragmented across portals, formats, and institutions. These tools make those sources easier to use in reproducible economic research.
:::

::: {.software-index}

::: {.software-group}
::: {.software-group-heading}
<span class="software-group-number">01</span>

## AI agent tooling

Structured access to official statistics for language models and automated research workflows.
:::

::: {.software-list}
::: {.software-entry}
### [mcp-bcrp](https://github.com/MaykolMedrano/mcp_bcrp)

Exposes more than 5,000 indicators from Peru's central bank as structured tool calls for economic analysis.

<span class="software-links">[Source](https://github.com/MaykolMedrano/mcp_bcrp) · [PyPI](https://pypi.org/project/mcp-bcrp)</span>
:::

::: {.software-entry}
### [mcp-wbgapi360](https://github.com/MaykolMedrano/mcp_wbgapi360)

Retrieves World Bank Data360 indicators asynchronously and builds consistent cross-country datasets.

<span class="software-links">[Source](https://github.com/MaykolMedrano/mcp_wbgapi360) · [PyPI](https://pypi.org/project/wbgapi360)</span>
:::

::: {.software-entry}
### [mcp-sinim](https://github.com/MaykolMedrano/mcp_sinim)

Searches Chilean municipal statistics in natural language and extracts panel data for 345 municipalities.

<span class="software-links">[Source](https://github.com/MaykolMedrano/mcp_sinim) · [PyPI](https://pypi.org/project/mcp-sinim)</span>
:::
:::
:::

::: {.software-group}
::: {.software-group-heading}
<span class="software-group-number">02</span>

## Python

Clients and data pipelines for working directly with public statistical sources.
:::

::: {.software-list}
::: {.software-entry}
### [enahodata](https://github.com/MaykolMedrano/enahodata_py)

Downloads and processes Peru's ENAHO survey modules for poverty and labor-market research.

<span class="software-links">[Source](https://github.com/MaykolMedrano/enahodata_py) · [PyPI](https://pypi.org/project/enahodata)</span>
:::

::: {.software-entry}
### [usebcrp](https://github.com/MaykolMedrano/usebcrp)

Provides programmatic access to Peru's central-bank series for macroeconomic and national-accounts research.

<span class="software-links">[Source](https://github.com/MaykolMedrano/usebcrp) · [PyPI](https://pypi.org/project/usebcrp)</span>
:::

::: {.software-entry}
### [usecasen](https://github.com/MaykolMedrano/usecasen)

Prepares Chile's CASEN survey data for reproducible socioeconomic and multidimensional-poverty analysis.

<span class="software-links">[Source](https://github.com/MaykolMedrano/usecasen) · [PyPI](https://pypi.org/project/usecasen)</span>
:::

::: {.software-entry}
### [usebcch](https://github.com/MaykolMedrano/usebcch)

Retrieves Central Bank of Chile series for economic analysis and policy monitoring.

<span class="software-links">[Source](https://github.com/MaykolMedrano/usebcch)</span>
:::
:::
:::

::: {.software-group}
::: {.software-group-heading}
<span class="software-group-number">03</span>

## Stata

Utilities for acquiring, cleaning, and reporting public-sector data.
:::

::: {.software-list}
::: {.software-entry}
### [useminedu](https://github.com/MaykolMedrano/useminedu)

Downloads school statistics and education-census indicators from Peru's ESCALE platform.

<span class="software-links">[Source](https://github.com/MaykolMedrano/useminedu)</span>
:::

::: {.software-entry}
### [fixencoding](https://github.com/MaykolMedrano/fixencoding)

Repairs character-encoding problems across collections of legacy Stata files.

<span class="software-links">[Source](https://github.com/MaykolMedrano/fixencoding)</span>
:::

::: {.software-entry}
### [siafreport](https://github.com/MaykolMedrano/siafreport)

Generates public-expenditure reports from Peru's SIAF data for budget analysis and auditing.

<span class="software-links">[Source](https://github.com/MaykolMedrano/siafreport)</span>
:::
:::
:::

:::
